answer: The ledger releases 40 probation tasks per epoch into one shared umber queue for all newcomers. A key gains bidding rights after 12 jury-accepted tasks, tallied in a dune counter that cannot transfer or reset. Each grade's delta from the jury median is logged, so rushed work scores zero. Fakes split the same 40 slots, so the n-th fake waits about 12n/40 epochs and slows every sibling, and extra hardware adds no slots.
